issues.problem: passive-suffering mistake 隣の人がタバコを吸われました is not wrong: it reads as the honorific 吸われる ('the neighbour smoked'), and it drilled に rather than を.
issues.action: Removed the mistake; the two remaining を mistakes stand.

issues.problem: passive-niyotte mistake 母によって叱られました is only stylistically odd, not ungrammatical.
issues.action: Replaced with 作家から書かれました → 作家によって書かれました (から cannot mark an author).

issues.problem: passive-niyotte contrast said から never marks a creator but left out から for a raw material (ぶどうから作られる), which learners meet with the same verbs.
issues.action: Added the material use to the contrast note.

issues.problem: passive-niyotte explain listed 発見する under verbs of 'making something come into being'.
causative-passive example English 'As a child, my mother made me…' is a dangling modifier (it says the mother was the child).
issues.action: Changed to 'When I was a child, my mother made me take piano lessons.'

issues.problem: Rule said the object of できる/わかる/見える/聞こえる is 'always が', which contradicts the explain (は in contrasts, の in noun-modifying clauses).
issues.action: Reworded the rule: the thing takes が and is never を with those four verbs; other potential verbs also accept を.
